ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: This diagram shows the life cycle of an insect. Using the stage labels in the diagram, what is the order of the insect's life stages from youngest to oldest?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image there is an insect life cycle loop. The label A at the lower right is placed next to an oval egg; the label B at the lower left is placed next to a smaller, not fully grown larva/nymph-like insect; the label C at the top is placed next to an adult insect with complete wings. Then reason: The question asks to arrange the insect life stages from youngest to oldest. An insect life cycle usually starts from an egg, then enters an immature stage such as a larva or nymph, and finally develops into a winged adult. Therefore the order is A, then B, then C.
